description: JSON parameter wire form: the generated JSON type is written by exec, batch and copyfrom and read back, and the stored document is described with the engine's own functions, compared with the same text as a literal and found by the document as a parameter; the document holds spacing, key order, a trailing zero, HTML characters and two- and four-byte UTF-8. Columns json (kept byte for byte) and jsonb (normalised by the server), and jsonb[] and json[] arrays, through the pgx emitter. A second connection uses pgx's simple protocol: Value returns the text.
